decisions: 2026-09-14: User requested a StringTune-inspired engineering scroll story on the existing homepage, using GSAP and Framer Motion. Keep the cream, blue, and orange identity; use one continuous 3D workbench across five chapters with natural-flow mobile and reduced-motion layouts.

decisions.decision: Homepage is a fourteen-chapter Project Vault narrative, not a gallery. Preserve the repoggits logo, cream/cobalt/orange palette and existing fonts. Use a custom R3F digital vault with Framer Motion, original photographic storyboards, responsive composition and reduced motion. Application routes remain separate.

2026-09-16 user direction supersedes the student-life narrative: dark-first product film, original engineer workspace artwork, live floating interfaces, fictional dashboard/discovery examples and working previews. Keep saved theme selection and existing application routes.

Remove fictional/demo projects from every homepage section, including hero previews. Replace with capability orbit, project-story typography, and discipline explorer. Animate semantic text throughout; links/buttons only fade to preserve pointer targets. Retain pause and reduced-motion support.
Use realistic original laptop/ESP32 Three.js geometry instead of abstract discipline shapes. Text block reveals use Framer Motion animate(), retain semantic DOM, and respect pause/reduced-motion.
